'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mali War]]
**A [[United Nations peacekeeping|United Nations peacekeeper]] is killed and four others are injured in an [[improvised explosive device]] attack in [[Ber, Mali|Ber]], [[Tombouctou Region]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/one-un-peacekeeper-killed-four-injured-north-mali-attack-2023-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least 27 people are killed and 53 others are injured after a [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar]] attack in [[Qoryoley]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/mortar-blast-kills-27-somalia-state-news-media-2023-06-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
**[[2023 Alberta wildfires]]
***Residents of [[Edson, Alberta|Edson]], west of [[Edmonton]], and [[Yellowhead County]], [[Alberta]], have been ordered to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] due to [[wildfire]]s in the area. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.6872260 (CBC)]
**[[2023 Nova Scotia wildfires]]
***Evacuation orders are lifted in [[Nova Scotia]], two weeks after wildfires swept through the area. [https://www.thestar.com/amp/news/canada/2023/06/09/wildfires-evacuation-orders-in-southwestern-nova-scotia-lifting-today.html (''The Star'')]
*[[2023 Colombia Cessna 206 crash]]
**[[President of Colombia|President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] confirms the successful rescue of the four [[Witoto]] children who had been missing in the [[Amazon natural region|Amazon rainforest]] since the [[Cessna 206]] they were traveling in [[Aviation accidents and incidents|crashed]] on May 1. The children were found alive but weak, while the bodies of the three adults accompanying them, including their mother, were found at the crash site. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/06/10/23/children-lost-for-40-days-in-colombian-amazon-found-alive (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*At least seven people are killed and 59 others are injured in [[flood]]s and [[storm]]s across [[Iran]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/news/201725/7-dead-59-injured-in-wind-storms-floods-in-Iran (Mehr)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iceland–Russia relations]]
**[[Iceland]] announces that it will suspend operations at [[Embassy of Iceland, Moscow|its embassy]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], beginning on August 1, saying that "commercial, cultural and political relations" with Russia are "at an all-time low" and that maintaining the [[embassy]] is "no longer justifiable". [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/18087 (''The Kyiv Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Commons Privileges Committee investigation into Boris Johnson]]
**[[2023 Uxbridge and South Ruislip by-election]]
***Former [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] [[resignation from the House of Commons of the United Kingdom|resigns]] from [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] after being told by the [[Commons Select Committee of Privileges|Privileges Committee]] that he will be sanctioned for misleading Parliament over his involvement in [[Partygate]]. His resignation triggers a [[by-election]] for his constituency of [[Uxbridge and South Ruislip (UK Parliament constituency)|Uxbridge and South Ruislip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-65863267 (BBC News)]
